verdict.rationale: Logseq's official docs describe a 'quickCapture' via its logseq:// protocol that can be added as a browser bookmarklet to capture short text and links (logseq-docs-11/17/22/27), which functions as a lightweight official capture flow. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated official web clipper for full articles or highlighted text (unlike Evernote/Notion-style clippers), and full-page/article capture would rely on third-party marketplace plugins not documented as official. missing for 10: official full-page/article clipper, highlight capture, browser extension beyond bookmarklet, independent hands-on confirmation of capture workflow quality.
